newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH NAFTA POLSKA TO PICK SALE ADVISER BY JUNE.
newsitem.headline: POLISH NAFTA POLSKA TO PICK SALE ADVISER BY JUNE.

text.p: Poland's Nafta Polska SA oil holding wants to pick by early June one out of the 17 consortia bidding to advise it on the privatisation of two largest oil refineries, a Nafta official said on Monday.
"I believe that late in May or early in June we will recommend to (Nafta Polska) management our choice for the advising firm," Jan Szczesny, Nafta's chief advisor, told reporters.
Szczesny was speaking after Nafta's tender commission opened bids from 17 consortia of international financial institutions. He added the tender committee would shortlist five bidders by May 15.

Under the oil sector's reform plan Nafta Polska, which now controls all state refineries, would offer 30 percent stakes in two refining groups led by Poland's largest Plock and Gdansk refineries. Investors will have an option ot acquire majority stakes following an implementation of agreed investment programmes.
